name: DetectSentiment
label: Detect Sentiment (AWS Comprehend)
description: Analyzes the sentiment of a given text using AWS Comprehend.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: LanguageCode
fields.label: Language Code
fields.description: The language of the input text (e.g., en, es, fr).

fields.name: Text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The text to analyze for sentiment.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the Comprehend service is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Sentiment
fields.label: Sentiment
fields.description: The detected sentiment: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL, or MIXED.

fields.name: ConfidenceScore
fields.label: Confidence Score
fields.description: Confidence score (0–1) for the detected sentiment.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS Comprehend.
